title: First run that teaches: create button, a 'how Studio works' strip, the starter production
gap: With no project open, every Studio stage shows only a sentence such as 'Open or create a project to write its script.' (SuitesShell.tsx:239-251), with no button. New project is hidden inside the ProjectHead ▾ popover. lib/starter.ts seedStarterProduction (a starter production with cast, shots and demo takes on Particl's own platform previews) is never called outside tests. On desktop there is no home: the mark opens Brief.
target: An empty stage shows a card with a 'New project' primary (reusing ProjectHead onCreate), recent projects, and a 4-step strip 'Brief → Beats → Boards → Takes' linking to each stage. Add 'Explore the starter production', which calls a new action on the existing /api/workbench/projects route; it seeds via seedStarterProduction and maps the result into a workbench draft. On desktop the mark opens a Studio home (reusing the StudioHome layout) with recent projects, running jobs and the next step.
respects_rules: The starter uses Particl's own neutral platform previews, not higgsfield.ai media. It is unbilled, and a starter the user does not want is archived rather than deleted.
